entities.name: Alanine-tRNA ligase
observations: The 768-aa query has 100% identity and full query coverage to reviewed Nostoc punctiforme alanine--tRNA ligase B2J876 (EC 6.1.1.7).
Catalyzes tRNA(Ala) + L-alanine + ATP = L-alanyl-tRNA(Ala) + AMP + diphosphate (Rhea RHEA:12540).
Reference annotation reports editing/deacylation of Ser-tRNA(Ala) and Gly-tRNA(Ala); reference binds one Zn2+ per subunit.
